source: GONG mrzqs zero-point corrected QuickReduce synoptic maps
missing_feature: one binary mask per delay; 1 means no eligible map
fieldline_stop_reason: Bounded compiled tracer replaces stalled PythonTracer. cap=60000 selected to avoid exhaustion on difficult maps while preserving physical endpoint checks.
trace_incomplete_policy: If any direction fails to leave the PFSS volume (max_steps/NaN) or any returned endpoint is not within 0.05 R_sun of the photosphere/source surface, keep direct Br/polarity statistics but mark open_field_fraction and expansion-factor aggregates missing; record all path-level trace failures.
